chapter: The Great Jazz Trio, Goodman and Japan
title: The 'I Come to Demolish Cleveland' record
summary: A short aside about a comic arrangement with strange noises recorded with Milt Hinton.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Now, you are going to Cleveland to do a concert, as opposed-­

Believe it or not, I did it. Some guy had written an arrangement as it was called "I Come to Demolish Cleveland." He had all sorts of funny noises and really weird sounds like laughing and stuff. Milt Hinton was on that record. That’s just an aside (laughs)
I’d like to hear that too. I was on the floor laughing when I made it. The funny sounds, you know, it sounded very strange.
